title: Branch stub R=150 r=100 beta=0.002: the verification cannot confirm the pattern
derivation: ratio F/(agree + 3 bound) = 87.0: the bound on the rounding of the verification (it grows as 1/sin^2 beta) is 87 times the part of its tolerance left after the engine's own error; the verification is not guaranteed and, measured on engine 0.4.2, its 3D intersection check differed by 2.9e-6 mm against a tolerance of 1.07e-6 mm (G10 FAIL, job REJECTED). The geometry itself is correct (31-digit reference); the angle is refused with its own code.
